thread:
Asha Rao: Quick check — want to run a small experiment on the pricing page: 2 tier-name variants + updated calculator and a clarified FAQ entry. Goal: improve trial-to-paid and reduce sales handoffs. Thoughts?
Ben Kim: +1. Can we test 'Team' vs 'Scale' for mid tier naming? those seem to influence perception.
Carlos Ortega: Agree on variant names. For the calc, can we make inputs: 'monthly active users' and 'avg tokens/day per user' and show both Hosted vs Dedicated est. cost? Should be simple.
Dana Li: We need clear analytics plan. Events: calculator_interaction, calc_estimate_view, select_tier_click, faq_expand. Also a UTM param mapping so we can tie to campaign.
Eve Thompson: For lead routing — any calc that estimates >$5k/mo should auto-flag to enterprise sales and create a lead in SFDC with tier_suggestion and estimate fields. We should also include a 'book a demo' CTA.
Asha Rao: Good. Proposed experiment matrix: A) Tier names: Team vs Growth. B) Calculator placement: inline vs modal. C) FAQ wording: conservative cost examples vs optimistic. We'll do 3 x 2 x 2 = 12 combos, but we can prioritize 4 cells only.
Ben Kim: Prioritize cells: (Growth, inline, conservative) and (Team, modal, optimistic) + two hybrids. Keep sample size small first.
Carlos Ortega: Dev asks: what's the exact formula for Dedicated estimate? Need per-GPU baseline and scaling assumptions. Dana, can you provide the cost model numbers? I can stub with approximate multipliers for now.
Dana Li: Posting the numbers here: base-hosted-per-token = $0.00003, quantization multiplier hosted=1, dedicated-baseline = $1200/GPU/month, tokens/sec-to-gpu mapping depends on model. For the calc UX we'll show a range: min/typical/max.
Eve Thompson: For SFDC mapping, fields: source=pricing_calc, estimate_usd, suggested_tier, demo_requested (bool). Also set lead_score=calc_estimate_usd/100. We'll tune.
mkt-bot: Deploy preview available at https://staging.redwood.ai/pricing/experiments/1732456789 (auto-preview created) :rocket:
Asha Rao: Nice — QA checklist: copy for A/B (submit by EOD Tue), analytics spec (Dana), calc UI mock (Carlos), SFDC mapping (Eve), GA/Amplitude events. Can owners confirm?
Carlos Ortega: Mock in Figma link: https://figma.com/file/abc123/pricing-calc — I'll hand over dev-ready tokens today.
Dana Li: Analytics spec in Google Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/analytics-pricing-calc — added Dedicated formula and event names.
Eve Thompson: I'll create SFDC fields and workflow, will test webhook for high-value leads.
Ben Kim: For FAQ copy, propose this short change: replace 'typical customers pay $X–$Y' with 'typical 10–50 seat apps pay $A–$B'. Shorter and more specific.
Asha Rao: Love that. Last Q: experiment length and success metric? Suggest 4 weeks or 500 calc interactions. Primary metric = conversion to paid trial within 14 days; secondary = demo requests.
Ben Kim: Sounds right. Also want a qualitative check — pull samples of NPS/feedback from the calc modal.
Carlos Ortega: Dev notes: will need feature flagging per variant. Ping me on PR review.
Asha Rao: Thanks team — I'll coordinate rollout and calendar invite for Wednesday stand-up. Will post final copy here when ready. :sparkles:
